title: Give renewal time to become life
meaning: The overall tone of your union can combine the ability to end an old phase with hope that also needs a place in the present.
text: In your shared life, bringing things to an end may be a noticeable way of moving forward. In the physical position, Death describes actions: clearing what is exhausted, changing a familiar form and closing a completed chapter. In energy, Death plays a different role, motivating you to release effort for a new phase instead of endlessly maintaining an earlier one. In emotions, the Star brings hope and a willingness to offer support while the continuation has yet to take shape. Renewal need not immediately feel easy or guarantee a successful outcome.

Imagine the first days after a move: the old keys are handed back, while boxes still line the walls. Together, you notice the light falling across the kitchen and discuss what you would gradually like to arrange. **Hope helps a new chapter begin when it can live among unfinished tasks.** You need not immediately prove that everything has improved. A small pleasure in the morning already gives the change a human scale that you can both experience.

The difficulty arises if renewal becomes a permanent background. You have barely settled before seeking another form, leaving what you achieved little time to become experience. Hope moves ahead: finish one more thing, and real life will begin. Letting go then deprives your union of the present. Between chapters, you can use the good things that made changing worthwhile.
